metadata.article_title: Taxes not to be imposed save by authority of law

article.title: Taxes not to be imposed save by authority of law
article.content: No tax shall be levied or collected except by authority of law.
article.html:
265Taxes not to be imposed save by authority of law

Article 265 · Part XII · General

No tax shall be levied or collected except by authority of law.
